items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Plus Pops Foster and those guys down in New Orleans had shown that it could be done

ctx.x: Plus Pops Foster and those guys down in New Orleans had shown that it could be done if that drummer would come down a little bit. Now, with that big foot a bass fiddle could not be heard, so they had to start tonin' down. And if you'll listen at Duke's earlier records, Sonny Greer and them, with Wellman Braud, how splendid they sounded. Now Sonny still has a heavier foot than Jo Jones, but the way they blended in and they swung it was --it showed that that rhythm section was teaming.
